series: trendwatching.com annual consumer trends (free Trend Briefing)
title: 10 Crucial Trends for 2013
notes: Labelled the December 2012 Trend Briefing; first archived 2012-11-10, so published by then. The intro calls them '10 crucial consumer trends (in random order)'. Quotes come from the overview teasers, which end in '...' (ellipsis dropped). Item 11 'MORE-ISM' is a Premium promotion, not a trend. target_year 2013 from the title. The 100+ page 2013 Trend Report (Premium) is not captured. Envisioning's archive holds a 2013 copy (issue #30); not used here.

entries.label: PRESUMERS & CUSTOWNERS
entries.quote: expect pre-ordering, crowdfunding and consumer equity to compete with traditional consumption in 2013
entries.subject: Crowdfunding, pre-ordering and consumer equity

entries.label: EMERGING²
entries.quote: it's now time to get ready for an explosion in products and services from emerging markets for emerging markets
entries.subject: Emerging-market brands serving other emerging markets

entries.label: MOBILE MOMENTS
entries.quote: in 2013, consumers will look to their mobile devices to maximize absolutely every moment , multi-if-not-hypertasking their experiences, purchases and communications
entries.subject: Mobile micro-moments

entries.label: NEW LIFE INSIDE
entries.quote: One sign-of-the-times eco-trend for 2013: the phenomenon of products and services that quite literally contain new life inside.
entries.subject: Plantable, biodegradable products

entries.label: APPSCRIPTIONS
entries.quote: In 2013, expect consumers to turn to the medical profession and medical institutions to certify and curate health apps and technologies, or to “prescribe” them, much as they prescribe medicines as part of a course of treatment
entries.subject: Prescribed and certified health apps

entries.label: CELEBRATION NATION
entries.quote: Emerging markets will proudly export and even flaunt their national and cultural heritage in the next 12 months.
entries.subject: Emerging-market brands exporting national heritage

entries.label: DATA MYNING
entries.quote: In 2013 expect savvy shoppers to start reversing the flow, as consumers seek to own and make the most of their lifestyle data
entries.subject: Consumers using their own data

entries.label: AGAIN MADE HERE
entries.quote: to trigger a resurgence in domestic manufacturing in established markets in 2013
entries.subject: Local manufacturing (3D printing, make-on-demand) in established markets
entries.note: Quote is the end of one long sentence listing the drivers (NEWISM, instant gratification, eco-concerns, stories, 3D printing).

entries.label: FULL FRONTAL
entries.quote: Brands must move from ‘having nothing to hide’ , to pro-actively showing and proving they have nothing to hide
entries.subject: Proactive brand transparency

entries.label: DEMANDING BRANDS
entries.quote: 2013 will see switched-on brands (i.e. brands that are embarking on the much-needed journey towards a more sustainable and socially-responsible future) demanding that their customers also contribute
entries.subject: Brands asking customers to act sustainably
